decisions.why: every product on this division is an accessory for the company's own AAC speech-generating devices and eye-gaze hardware (TD Pilot/TD I-Series chargers, connection cables and batteries, eye-tracker mounting plates, PCEye brackets, wheelchair mounts) — accessories for 'eye gaze, communication devices' named in the digital:aac vocabulary entry, not a general IT-accessories range.

the division carries the company's own AAC communication software and access apps (TD Snap, TD Talk, TD Phone, TD Control, TD Browse, Boardmaker 7, Pathways for Snap Scene, Gaze Viewer) — 'communication devices' and the environmental-control/access-switch software the digital:aac vocabulary entry names, read against the company's own storefront heading.
